intro: Patrones para investigación del equipo, no veredictos de trampas. Estas comprobaciones no guardan indicios, modifican cuentas ni aplican sanciones. Se excluyen los bots oficiales del juego.
loadError: Could not compute findings. Retry with the 7-day window.
coverage: Combat accounting: {{scanned}} recent attacks scanned; {{eligible}} have comparable snapshot values, {{missing}} lack versioned snapshots, and {{malformed}} have missing or invalid comparisons.
snapshotCap: Combat scan capped at the latest 1,000 attacks.
limited: Showing at most 25 findings per type. Additional matches exist for: {{types}}.
empty: No findings in the returned results match these filters. This does not establish that all activity is legitimate.
sampleNote: Up to 10 supporting records per finding; examples are not the full history. Transfer cycles show one transfer ID per direction. Raw login identifiers, message content, and private transfer notes are excluded.

rules.ACCOUNT_FEEDING: At least 6 gold transfers received from at least 3 different players in the selected period. Tax rows are excluded. A shared login pattern is additional context, not a requirement. Up to 20 senders are listed.
rules.TRANSFER_RING: A two- or three-player directed transfer cycle, with at least 2 transfers along every direction in the cycle. Amounts are gross movement, not profit; this does not establish that the same gold returned.
rules.ATTACK_FARMING: At least 8 attacks on the same defender, at least 90% won by the attacker, positive total pillage, and attacker losses no greater than 10% of defender losses. All attacks must have recorded loss totals and defender losses must be positive.
rules.COMBAT_ACCOUNTING: Captured before/after gold must reconcile with recorded pillage; attack turns and stamina must reconcile with turns spent; active-unit reductions must reconcile with recorded casualties including wounded. Each comparison requires valid recorded values.
rules.RECRUITMENT_CONCENTRATION: At least 20 recruiting clicks by a player, with at least 80% directed to one other player in the selected period. Automatic citizen rewards and system recruiters are excluded.
rules.ALLIANCE_TREASURY: At least 5 withdrawals or loans to one beneficiary representing at least 80% of that alliance’s recorded withdrawal/loan gold in the period. Fees and taxes are excluded.
rules.SOCIAL_BURST: At least 50 retained chat messages from one player in a fixed 10-minute bucket. Private and group chats count; message content is not inspected. Legacy inbox broadcasts are excluded.

limitations.ACCOUNT_FEEDING: Gifts, alliance support, and shared households can explain this pattern. Shared network/browser hashes are not device identity or proof of common ownership. Login context is limited to retained records within the selected period, at most 30 days.
limitations.TRANSFER_RING: Repayments, mutual support, and ordinary trading can create cycles. This check finds repeated directed edges, not intent, profit, chronological laundering, or common account ownership.
limitations.ATTACK_FARMING: A rivalry, war, or a stronger army attacking a weaker target can explain this. Pair it with transfer and login context before drawing conclusions. Missing losses exclude a pair from this check.
limitations.COMBAT_ACCOUNTING: This is a data-consistency warning, not evidence of player misconduct. Engine bugs or historical logging defects may explain it. Legacy or malformed comparisons are skipped and reported in coverage.
limitations.RECRUITMENT_CONCENTRATION: Auto-recruiting is supported by the game. Small player populations and friends recruiting each other can legitimately concentrate clicks. Timing alone is not a signal.
limitations.ALLIANCE_TREASURY: Alliance leaders may intentionally fund a champion or issue loans. Check roles, authorization, and alliance policy. This does not establish an unauthorized withdrawal.
limitations.SOCIAL_BURST: Active conversations, staff activity, or legitimate coordination can produce bursts. This is a fixed time bucket rather than a sliding window and does not identify spam content.

metrics.sharedLoginPattern: Shares a network/browser pattern with a sampled sender
metrics.goldCirculated: Gross gold moved around the cycle
